limitations: Intervals are visually selected, not independently motion-annotated ground truth.
CrossFit source is an edited instructional sequence with no clean continuous single cycle in selected interval.
Pose and hand landmarks have camera, scale, occlusion, and detector uncertainty.
No cross-video numeric ranking or 2D-to-3D angle comparison was performed.
Root must still use final rendered camera projection for any renderer comparison.
2D camera and occlusion affect angles; no biomechanics certification.
Hand detection coverage is not grip correctness.
Review whole reps, floor/bar contacts, thumbs and encoded phone-size output.
